summary: Formation-lap race-start event handler. Emits per-driver session commentary events only when a race is active, the track condition state is nonzero, the race phase is not post-race, and the driver is not the player. Race/practice sessions (session type <= 6) and World Championship mode emit the generic event code 6; a championship weekend (session type 7) outside World Championship mode emits a formation-lap position event (180/181/182) selected by field 0x342C when the position counter is within one lap of the current lap number.

operations.description: Function identity: formation-lap race-start event handler (legacy ABI label AI_Formation_Lap_Race_Start), dispatched per frame from the AI session event pipeline.
Outer guard: race must be active (dword_7D0308 nonzero), otherwise return immediately.
Track-condition guard: flt_7CF3C8 must be nonzero and race phase (dword_7C56A8) must not be 8 (post-race).
Initialize the local 8-DWORD event-parameter buffer v4 with sentinel values.
Skip the player's own events: this driver's driver ID (field 0x4894) must differ from the player vehicle's driver ID (dword_7C54E8 + 0x4894), and session type (dword_7C56A4) must be >= 0.
Session-type branch: if dword_7C56A4 <= 6 (race/practice), fall through to generic event code 6.
Session-type branch: if dword_7C56A4 != 7 (championship weekend), return without emitting an event.
Championship-mode branch: if dword_7D0410 == 5 (World Championship), fall through to generic event code 6 instead of position-specific events.
v1 (lap_number) = a1[4111], the current lap counter at field 0x403C.
v2 (formation_lap_position) = a1[3340], the formation-lap position counter at field 0x3430.
Lap-proximity guard: emit only when the formation-lap position counter v2 is within one lap of the lap number v1 (v2 >= v1 - 1 && v2 <= v1 + 1).
Select the formation-lap position event code from field 0x342C: 1 -> 180, 2 -> 181, 3 -> 182; any other value returns without emitting.
Generic path sets event_code v3 = 6 for race/practice sessions and World Championship mode.
DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v4, event_code v3, a1[4647] driver index at field 0x489C, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) fills the event-parameter buffer for the driver.
InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v4) inserts the built event row into the session event table.
Early return when the session type is not 7 after the position-specific branch is ruled out.
Early return from the switch default when field 0x342C holds no known formation-lap position status.
